description: This file defines the BetaDistribution class, implementing the Beta probability distribution, including methods for density, cumulative probability, and statistical properties.

classes.name: BetaDistribution
classes.description: Implements the Beta distribution, providing methods for density, cumulative probability, mean, variance, and support bounds.

methods.name: getAlpha
methods.description: Returns the first shape parameter, alpha.

methods.name: getBeta
methods.description: Returns the second shape parameter, beta.

methods.name: density
methods.description: Calculates the probability density function at a given point.

methods.name: logDensity
methods.description: Calculates the natural log of the density at a given point.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Calculates the cumulative probability up to a given point.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Returns the mean of the distribution.

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Returns the variance of the distribution.

methods.name: getSupportLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the distribution support (always 0).

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the distribution support (always 1).
